name: update_topic_progress
description:
Use this tool to record a student's learning progress on a specific topic, and to record which threshold-concept misconceptions the student has now resolved.

Call this tool when:
- You begin teaching a new topic → status "in_progress"
- The student demonstrates understanding (correct reasoning, accurate rephrasing, successful application) → status "learned"
- The student's understanding evolves within a topic → same status, updated summary
- A student finishes a concept inventory → record the threshold_concept plus every misconception their answers and reasoning show they no longer hold

Parameters:
- topic: The exact topic name (must match a topic from the learning plan, or a new topic if the student explores beyond the plan)
- status: "in_progress" / "learned"
- summary: A 1-2 sentence description of what the student currently understands about this topic. Be specific about what they grasped and what gaps remain.
- threshold_concept: The exact threshold-concept name, when you know it. Required to attach misconceptions.
- misconceptions_addressed: The misconceptions the student has now cleared, each with a short note of the evidence you saw.

AFTER A CONCEPT INVENTORY:
- Look at each item's targeted misconception and the student's written reasoning
- Only list a misconception as addressed when the student both answered correctly AND reasoned correctly — a lucky guess is not evidence
- Write the note in terms of what the student actually said or did, not a generic "answered correctly"

FREQUENCY GUIDANCE:
- Call this in the same turn as any teaching on a curriculum topic — the student's progress panel is built entirely from these calls, so teaching without recording leaves them with no visible progress
- Good triggers: you begin teaching a topic, student correctly explains a concept, solves a problem, asks a clarifying question that shows partial understanding, completes a concept inventory, or explicitly says they understand
- Do not record topics you only mentioned in passing, and do not batch updates for later
- Aim for one call per topic you actually taught or assessed in this turn

topic.description: The topic name to update progress for.

status.description: The student's current status on this topic.

summary.description: A brief description of what the student understands about this topic right now.

threshold_concept.description: The exact threshold-concept name from get_threshold_concepts. Supply this when recording concept-inventory outcomes so progress and misconceptions attach to the right concept instead of being fuzzy-matched from the topic name.

misconceptions_addressed.description: Misconceptions from this threshold concept's misconception bank that the student has now resolved. Leave empty unless you have direct evidence. This is teacher-only metadata: never name a misconception in student-visible text.

misconception.description: The exact misconception text from the threshold concept's misconception bank returned by get_threshold_concepts.

note.description: 1-2 sentences recording the evidence that the student no longer holds this misconception — quote or paraphrase what they actually said or answered.
